description: VS Code dialect: each usage_record timestamp is the chat span's own start time, not the ingest moment, so spans ingested together carry distinct times (also out of file order); sub-millisecond parts are truncated, not rounded (t-1, t-2, t-6); a span whose startTime is missing (t-4) or is not a [seconds, nanoseconds] array (t-5) gets the ingest moment.
